candidates.statement: For every knot K ⊂S3 we have (jsK ∪js∗ K) ⊂bsK. Futer, Kalfagianni and Purcell [4] veriﬁed the conjecture for adequate knots (see Deﬁ- nition 3.5 for terminology). The works of Garoufalidis and Dunﬁeld [3] and Garoufalidis and van der Veen [11] veriﬁed the conjecture for a certain 2-parameter family of closed 3-braids, called 2-fusion knots. More recently, Lee and van der Veen [23] have proved the conjecture for several more 3-string pretzel knots.
